**Acceptance Criteria**
REQ-01, REQ-02, and REQ-04 are functionally implemented: `Rule`/`RawRule` accept `description`, seeded/live rules have descriptions, and the reference projection renders descriptions with prose suffixes. REQ-03 is functionally close, but its required CLI-level verification is incomplete.

**Architecture**
No new domain/storage/command/CLI boundary violations found in the reviewed paths. The reference projection still writes through `IssueStore`.

**Functional Paradigm**
No blocking issues found.

**Correctness And Invariants**
No unsafe code, PID handling, gate semantics, event logging, or atomic-write regressions found in this change set.

**Testing**
Used the provided passed `cargo-ci` gate as primary test evidence. I also ran `./scripts/jit-validate.sh`; it passed.

**Jit Issue Management**
The prerequisite dependency is marked `done`, and `unmet_dependencies` is empty.

1. **F1 [medium]** The rule-description fallback was implemented by making every registry-first TOML `text-field` optional in `load_toml_scope_items`, not just rule descriptions. This broadens the generic item-source contract and can silently turn malformed custom registry entries into items whose display text is the id. It also conflicts with public docs that still describe `text-field` as the display-text field and `TomlSourceMissingField` as covering missing `id-field` or `text-field`. See [domain/item.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/domain/item.rs:1561), [config.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/config.rs:754), and [domain/item.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/domain/item.rs:661).
2. **F2 [medium]** REQ-03 requires `jit item show @/rule/<name>` to display the rule description with name fallback verified by test, but the CLI test only asserts that `@/rule/label-format` resolves and has kind `"rule"`; it does not assert `item.text` contains the description, and the fallback is only covered by the lower-level TOML loader test. See [item_cli_tests.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/tests/item_cli_tests.rs:844).
3. **F3 [low]** The live `.jit/config.toml` comment above `[item_kinds.rule]` still says rules project `name` as both self-id and display text and “carry no separate free-text field,” directly contradicting the new `description` field and `text-field = "description"`. See [.jit/config.toml](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/.jit/config.toml:143).

Total findings: 3
